actions.reason: C0001 lacks adjusted-significant molecular support in CNV and WXS (only nominal, uncorrected trends), and cross-modal evidence is weak and inconsistent (only CT positive at modality level, no patient positive across all estimable modalities, low resampling stability ARI 0.16). No credible structural revision is indicated, so the candidate is insufficiently defensible.

C0002 has coherent adjusted-significant CNV support (chr12p/12q gain, elevated FGA) corroborated by significant WXS DST enrichment, with modest but positive cross-modal membership and no set-level technical confounder. Retained as a discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0003 is defined by a strong, adjusted-significant BAP1 enrichment with moderate cross-modal support (WXS and CNV positive, ARI 0.558). A tissue-source-site imbalance is present and warrants caution, but the molecular signal is coherent and the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0004 shows a significant PBRM1 enrichment with the strongest cross-modal coherence (WSI, WXS, CNV positive; no zero-support patients; ARI 0.75). Several technical associations (site, CT manufacturer, scanner model) warrant caution, but the molecular and structural evidence supports retaining this candidate for downstream validation.

C0005 lacks adjusted-significant molecular features (only nominal VHL-high/PBRM1-low trends), but its internal structure is highly stable (ARI 1.0) with a dominant WXS signal and no set-level technical confounder. It remains a plausible discovery-stage candidate despite weak identity evidence.

C0006 has a distinctive, adjusted-significant VHL-wild-type/PBRM1-depleted WXS signature with stable internal structure (ARI 0.495). A CT scanner-model imbalance is present and warrants caution, but the molecular signal is coherent and defensible for downstream validation.
